# laravelforge_recipes (Resource)

Manages a recipe in the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_recipes" "deploy_tooling" {
  organization = "my-org"
  name         = "Install build tooling"
  user         = "forge"
  script       = <<-EOT
    sudo apt-get update
    sudo apt-get install -y jq
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Recipe.
- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `script` (String) The script that should be executed.
- `user` (String) The user that the Recipe should be executed as.

### Optional

- `recipe` (Number) The recipe ID
- `team_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date the Recipe was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The date the Recipe was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_recipes.example my-org/123
```
